title: Druid
text:
The Druid is a strength/intelligence-oriented class that specializes in shapeshifting and nature spells.

== Ascendancy classes ==
Druids can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:

Oracle
Shaman
TBA


== Lore ==
The Druid is an Ezomyte who was once part of the Druids of Skothe, an ancient order that venerated the Azmeri Draíocht and practiced the mystic arts of the Maji. The Druids were wiped out by the King in the Mists and his cultists, who deceived them by disguising himself as a Maji of the old.
The Druid is the last of his kind, having managed to avoid being hunted down by hiding in the wilderness as a beast. Years later, he manages to regain his human form, but had lost most of his memories, and he wanders Wraeclast in search of his wife, Aoife.


== Dialogues ==


=== Entering locations ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Riverbank: Och... Seems the Draíocht's not done with me yet.
Clearfell Encampment: This is no stronghold. Wouldnae stand up to a stiff breeze.
Clearfell:
Mud Burrow: Tunnels of mud and filth... aye, this reeks o' the Devourer's lair.
The Grelwood:
The Red Vale: So much blood spilled here, the earth still bleeds.
The Grim Tangle: These roots willnae budge for me.
Cemetery of the Eternals: The dead find no rest here.
Mausoleum of the Praetor: Draven... a name that lingers like a bad smell.
Tomb of the Consort: A place of undeath... crying out for release.
Hunting Grounds: Huntin' grounds... Best be careful shapeshiftin', lest I take an arrow to the arse.
Freythorn: Feels as though I've walked this road afore...
Ogham Farmlands: These fields bloom with naught but dead bodies.
Ogham Village: Rot and flame. Something foul's taken hold here.
The Manor Ramparts: How very like a tyrant, to hide within his walls...
Ogham Manor: The Wolf's reckoning draws near.


==== Act 2 ====
Vastiri Outskirts: Each grain o' sand here has a story all its own.
The Ardura Caravan: They move with the wind, these folk. Cannae help but admire it.
Mawdun Quarry: The Faridun beat the drums of war...
Mawdun Mine: They sealed the mine... and left the stragglers to die.
The Halani Gates (1): Gate's shut. That wasnae part o' the plan.
Traitor's Passage: The dark hides all manner o' creatures.
The Halani Gates (2): The war for the Vastiri has already begun.
Mastodon Badlands: Sand, black as the heart of a necromancer.
The Bone Pits: Bones that should've fed the land... and not one's been laid to rest.
Keth: Hard to believe the Vastiri once bloomed with life and colour.
The Lost City: Once a city... now a graveyard.
Buried Shrines: They built the shrines... but none came to answer.
Valley of the Titans: Titans once walked here. Can almost hear their footsteps still.
The Titan Grotto: Hard to fathom what this place was like, when Titans still roamed.
Deshar: Their dead watch from on high.
Path of Mourning: The wind bites like a blade up here.
The Spires of Deshar:
The Dreadnought: Long road to get here. I'll not falter now.
Dreadnought Vanguard: Close now! Keep movin'!
Trial of the Sekhemas: So this is where the Maraketh forge their finest.
Lightless Passage: Freshly dug. These Abyssals move quickly.
The Well of Souls: There's no end to this place...


==== Act 3 ====
Sandswept Marsh: Och... I werenae made for heat like this.
Ziggurat Encampment: Treasure hunters? They've a death wish, diggin' for treasure out here.
Jungle Ruins: The jungle has reclaimed what the Vaal sought to conquer.
The Venom Crypts: Snakes wearin' the dead like skin... Vile work.
Infested Barrens:
The Azak Bog: Death haunts this place. Must be the Azak's doing.
Chimeral Wetlands: Beauty like this always hides teeth.
Jiquani's Machinarium: A monument to the hubris of the Vaal.
Jiquani's Sanctum: More o' this wretched technology... Best confer with Alva.
The Matlan Waterways: Let's see if these Azak are as vicious as Servi says.
The Drowned City: Another city, lost to the ravages of time...
Apex of Filth: Mercy me - that's a stench to curl the hairs!
The Molten Vault: This way lies gold, says Oswald. And danger, no doubt.
Temple of Kopec: Heat like this... cannae be natural.
Utzaal: The dead city of Utzaal, reborn.
Aggorat: The Vaal at the height of empire... soon to crumble to dust.
The Black Chambers: More monuments to death...
The Ziggurat Refuge: So this is to be our refuge... It's no Caer Tarth, but it'll serve.
The Temple of Chaos: Lucky for me... chaos is where I thrive.


=== Boss defeated ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Bloated Miller: Sleep, now. Whatever's left of ye.
Beira of the Rotten Pack: A grave sickness nests in these roots...
The Devourer: You've gorged on the good folk of Clearfell long enough.
The Brambleghast: The rot is cut out, root and stem.
The Rust King: Rest now, if ye still can.
The Rotten Druid: Peace, brother. I only hope ye'd do the same for me.
Draven, the Eternal Praetor: A warlord in life, a damn nuisance in death.
Asinia, the Praetor's Consort: Yer grip on this world is broken. Let the earth take ye.
Lachlann of Endless Lament: Yer memory twisted into madness. Let the Draíocht spare me the same.
The Crowbell: Silence. At bloody last.
The King in the Mists:
The Executioner: The hand that held the rope lies still!
Candlemass, the Living Rite: Corruption breathes life where none should be.
Count Geonor: The wilds reclaim what ye defiled.


==== Act 2 ====
Rathbreaker: Affronts to nature, every last one of 'em.
Rudja, the Dread Engineer:
Balbala, the Traitor: A coin... Was this part of her punishment?
Jamanra, the Risen King: Ha! He knows he's outmatched! That's why he runs.
Ekbab, Ancient Steed: Dead now, the both o' ye... and better off for it.
Kabala, Constrictor Queen: One less coil around this desert's throat.
Azarian, the Forsaken Son:
Zalmarath, the Colossus: The land will carry yer weight no longer.
Tor Gul, the Defiler: I'll not abide yer gross perversions of life any longer!
Jamanra, the Abomination: Ye've a grave waitin' for you, Jamanra.


==== Act 3 ====
Rootdredge: That's enough filth for one day.
Mighty Silverfist: Down ye go, ya great beast! May the roots take ya.
Ignagduk, the Bog Witch: Good riddance! Ye insulted the very earth on which ye walked.
Xyclucian, the Chimeral: This bears the mark o' Chaos.
Blackjaw, the Remnant: Had more than my fill o' these cursed contraptions!
Zicoatl, Warden of the Core: The Vaal don't give anythin' for free, do they?
Mektul, the Forgemaster: The hammer falls... and stays fallen!
The Queen of Filth: Yer very bein' was a crime against nature.
Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun: Burn out, ye daft bastard!
Viper Napuatzi: Did I slay the viper... or did she just shed her skin?
Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge: Failed - just like yer precious queen.


=== Level up ===
Reaching level 2: Still breathin'. That's a start.
Reaching level 3: Still remember how to fight.
Reaching level 5: The wild stirs within.
Reaching level 10: The Draíocht havenae forsaken me.
Reaching level 15: Takes more than fate to fell me.
Reaching level 20: Step by bloody step.
Reaching level 30: Strength endures where memory fades.
Reaching level 40: The Draíocht sees me now.
Reaching level 50: Her memory guides me, not haunts me.
Reaching level 60: The Draíocht flows through me - and I through it.
Reaching level 70: I've made peace with what I was... and what I am.
Reaching level 80: No wound, no loss can break me now!
Reaching level 90: Everythin', for Aoife!
Reaching level 100: I am whole once more!


=== Miscellaneous ===


==== Post-King in the Mists cutscene ====
The King in the Mists:Hahahaha! Your path will always lead back to me...
Aoife: Oh, how good it is to see you again...
Druid: Aoife...? C-can it be?
Aoife: Yes. I'm here, love.
Druid: But how...?
Aoife: It matters not. Tell me... do you feel it? Your memories returning.
Druid: I feel it, aye. But they're... fractured. There's still so much I dinnae understand.
Aoife: Remember how we were drawn to him... believing him one of the Maji of old.
Druid: Aye... we were fools...
Aoife: Not fools... just deceived. Even I could not see the King's true face until it was too late.And when I did, he... took me from you.
Druid: I should have saved ye... I should have done more-
Aoife: Hush... that is not your blame to carry. That grief made you wander the wilds, lost to all but your own pain.
Druid: I... remember... years of solitude... roaming...
Aoife: And yet here you are. That is what matters.
Druid: Nay... none of it matters. Not without you.
Aoife: Just know... that I am with you, still...
Druid: Wait... dinnae leave me now!
Druid: Aoife...


==== Full inventory ====
A Druid knows to travel light.
Cannae carry any more.
Pack's heavy enough already.
I'm full up.


==== Using ability in town ====
Folk here wouldnae take kindly to that.
Not the place for such things.
Best not to scare the locals.
That'd have me out on my ear.
That'd have me out on me arse.


==== Using well ====
Fresh as morning dew.
That'll keep me goin'.
Nature provides, as ever.
Ready for the road.


==== Respec passive point ====
Time I turned over a new leaf.
Old roots find new soil.
Never too old to start afresh.
Old dog. New tricks.
Old wolf. New tricks.
